description: Implementation of XPU generator class and related functions for managing RNG state, seed, offset, and generator creation for XPU devices within the ATen library.

classes.name: XPUGeneratorState
classes.description: Represents the internal state of an XPU RNG, including seed and offset.

classes.name: XPUGeneratorImpl
classes.description: Implementation of RNG generator for XPU devices, managing seed, offset, and state.

methods.name: XPUGeneratorState::clone
methods.description: Creates a clone of the generator state.

methods.name: XPUGeneratorState::increase
methods.description: Increases the internal offset based on the specified increment.

methods.name: XPUGeneratorImpl::set_current_seed
methods.description: Sets the current seed for the generator.

methods.name: XPUGeneratorImpl::set_offset
methods.description: Sets the offset for the generator.

methods.name: XPUGeneratorImpl::seed
methods.description: Generates a new seed and sets it.

methods.name: XPUGeneratorImpl::get_state
methods.description: Returns the RNG state as a tensor.

methods.name: XPUGeneratorImpl::set_state
methods.description: Sets the RNG state from a tensor.

methods.name: XPUGeneratorImpl::set_philox_offset_per_thread
methods.description: Sets the per-thread offset for Philox RNG.

methods.name: XPUGeneratorImpl::philox_xpu_state
methods.description: Returns the current Philox state with an increment.

methods.name: XPUGeneratorImpl::philox_engine_inputs
methods.description: Returns the seed and offset pair for the engine.
